tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: App ground. Every screen sits on this; nothing else is this dark/light.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the sidebar. One step off the ground; no shadow needed in dark.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Hover rows, input fields, segmented-control track, chart gridlines' ground.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Pressed state, selected row, chip fill.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders. Borders, not shadows, separate surfaces.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and amounts. 15.6:1 on bg-000 dark, 15.9:1 light.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, account masks, captions. 7.4:1 dark, 6.0:1 light on bg-000.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels, axis ticks. Never body copy.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Keel green: primary actions, active nav, the net-worth line. Also means income/positive. 10.7:1 on bg-000 dark; 5.6:1 on bg-000 light.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a brand fill.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Brand at rest: budget 'on track' bars, selected chips, assistant message ground.

tokens.name: spend
tokens.usage: Spending and negative change. Coral, not red, so warnings (amber) stay distinct. 6.9:1 dark, 5.9:1 light.

tokens.name: spend-tint
tokens.usage: Over-budget bar track, spend chart fill.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Attention: pending, unreviewed, budget nearly spent, stale sync. 10.9:1 dark, 6.9:1 light.

tokens.name: amber-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for amber badges and the 80–100% budget band.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Second series colour in charts (investments, transfers). Differs from brand in lightness, not hue alone.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Third series colour (recurring). Chart use only.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px outside the control. 3:1 against both grounds.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen: the headline figure's label or the brand name.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary line of a row, captions, chart legends.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow labels and nav items.

styles.name: amount-xl
styles.usage: The one headline number on a screen (net worth, month spend).

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Every amount in a row or table. Tabular figures; sign always shown for change.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips, between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding; gap between cards on phone.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; page gutter on phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section gap; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between screen title and first card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of a screen on desktop; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, list-row hover, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Progress bars, segmented controls, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers and the assistant sheet only. Cards use hairline, never shadow.
